promise: Provide a record $100 billion package to support the world's poorest countries over fiscal years 2026-2028
description: The 21st replenishment of the World Bank's International Development Association, finalized in December 2024, produced a record financing package of up to $100 billion for fiscal years 2026-2028. Donors including the UK, which pledged £1.98 billion, committed during the replenishment; delivery runs through June 30, 2028.
evidence: IDA21 replenishment finalized December 2024 at up to $100bn for FY2026-28
UK pledged £1.98bn; disbursement cycle runs to June 30, 2028
